cat > build3.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
import itertools

base = "Nc1nc2c([nH]1)[{a20}:20](O)[{a21}:21]3C(=O)c4c([{a22}:22]3[{a23}:23](C)2)c(c[nH]4)c5[nH]c(=O)c(c6c[nH]c7cc(Br)ccc76)nc5"
tags = ["C@H","C@@H"]
desired = {20:'R', 22:'S', 23:'R'}  # cO=R, cX=S, cA=R
for t20,t21,t22,t23 in itertools.product(tags,tags,tags,tags):
    s = base.format(a20=t20,a21=t21,a22=t22,a23=t23)
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
    if m is None: continue
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
    centers = dict()
    for idx,cip in Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False):
        centers[idx]=cip
    amap = {a.GetAtomMapNum(): a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
    cip = {k: centers.get(amap[k]) for k in (20,21,22,23)}
    if cip[20]==desired[20] and cip[22]==desired[22] and cip[23]==desired[23]:
        print("MATCH:", t20,t21,t22,t23, "->", cip)
        print("   SMILES:", s)
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

smis = {
 "cB=S": "Nc1nc2c([nH]1)[C@H:20](O)[C@H:21]3C(=O)c4c([C@H:22]3[C@@H:23](C)2)c(c[nH]4)c5[nH]c(=O)c(c6c[nH]c7cc(Br)ccc76)nc5",
 "cB=R": "Nc1nc2c([nH]1)[C@H:20](O)[C@@H:21]3C(=O)c4c([C@H:22]3[C@@H:23](C)2)c(c[nH]4)c5[nH]c(=O)c(c6c[nH]c7cc(Br)ccc76)nc5",
}
for name,s in smis.items():
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
    mh = Chem.AddHs(m)
    amap = {a.GetAtomMapNum(): a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
    # embed several conformers
    ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    ps.randomSeed = 42
    cids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh, numConfs=10, params=ps)
    energies = []
    for cid in cids:
        try:
            e = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, confId=cid, maxIters=500)
            ff = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mh, AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh), confId=cid)
            energies.append((ff.CalcEnergy(), cid))
        except Exception as ex:
            pass
    energies.sort()
    E0, cid0 = energies[0]
    # H atoms on cX(22) and cB(21)
    def hatom(idx):
        for nb in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors():
            if nb.GetAtomicNum()==1: return nb.GetIdx()
    hX = hatom(amap[22]); hB = hatom(amap[21])
    conf = mh.GetConformer(cid0)
    p = lambda i: np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))
    # dihedral hX-cX-cB-hB
    b0,b1,b2,b3 = p(hX),p(amap[22]),p(amap[21]),p(hB)
    v1 = b1-b0; v2 = b2-b1; v3 = b3-b2
    n1 = np.cross(v1,v2); n2 = np.cross(v2,v3)
    n1/=np.linalg.norm(n1); n2/=np.linalg.norm(n2)
    dih = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(n1,n2),-1,1)))
    print(name, "best MMFF E=%.2f kcal/mol, hX-cX-cB-hB dihedral=%.1f deg"%(E0,dih), "nconfs:", len(energies))
EOF

    p = line.split()
    syms.append(p[0]); coords.append([float(p[1]),float(p[2]),float(p[3])])
assert n == tmpl.GetNumAtoms(), (n, tmpl.GetNumAtoms())
# check element order matches template

        if d < dmin:
            dmin, pair = d, (pts[i][0], i, pts[j][0], j)
print("min interatomic distance: %.3f A  (%s[%d] - %s[%d])" % (dmin, pair[0],pair[1],pair[2],pair[3]))
print("composition:", dict(Counter(p[0] for p in pts)))
print("total atoms:", len(pts))
